notes.title: JUST RELEASED: FUTA TALES NOW AVAILABLE 🍌🏙
notes.content:
Some say it's a myth...
Some say they've vanished from town...
But we're sure you're glad THEY DIDN'T

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40735653/7fb25b53f3d2b14eb929245d80cfc9c31aed3021.jpg


These ladies are packing HEAT!

Futa City is a futa-filled anthology series featuring 5 unique standalone stories, each with their own taste of the taboo. Every story is depicted as a dynamic visual novel, right up until the clothes start flying off. Then we get a whole lot more immersive.

From superheroes to reality-tv housewives, our futas are coming from all walks of the wild life. Prepare to wear many hats, and then take them off!

Would you like to know more?

notes.title: 📣 Announcement: Bambie! - Embrace the Plastic Magic! 🩰🎮
notes.content:
Calling all gamers and fans of enchanting adventures! Prepare to enter a world of whimsy and delight with "Bambie!". Get ready to embark on a captivating journey filled with charm, hornyness, and plastic!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40735653/6620b0c468cd7be585c9d6a9879eadac46e329b9.jpg

Meet Barbara, our delightful protagonist, and her fabulous friends: Chelsea, the caring dentist; Marge, the brilliant doctor; Nina, the agile gymnast; and Stacey, the charismatic bartender. These unique characters will charm you with their personalities and skills.

But the adventure doesn't end there! Encounter Ryan and Kent, two charming guys who will add more excitement to your journey.

Explore four enchanting scenes filled with magic and wonder. Immerse yourself in a world where dreams come true and fantasies become reality.

      {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40735653/8c79d498e1f6380a5c14aa62d4da7bfdfcc0df7e.gif


Whishlist now here!

🗓️ Save the date! "Bambie!" releases next Friday, on the 21st, bringing pink-tastic enchantment and to the gaming world.
